bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
base="$HOME/Project/Gserver"
matches=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  d="${p%/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py}"
  origin="$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#\.git$##; s#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#' || true)"
  if [[ "$origin" == 'https://github.com/G-ACE-inc/server-core' ]] && [[ -z "$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain -- scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py)" ]]; then matches+=("$d"); fi
done < <(find "$base" -maxdepth 6 -type f -path '*/scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py' -not -path '*/.worktrees/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0)
if [[ ${#matches[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then echo "NOTICE_OUTPUT_HELPER_MATCHES=${#matches[@]}"; exit 65; fi
cd "${matches[0]}"
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py req_20261128003000000000b821 --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
